points.why: Names Shifting the Burden explicitly; it calls it the 'addiction' variant rather than the intervenor variant, which the rubric only marks as ideal.
Identifies agency shifts as the quick fix and recruiting, mentoring and retaining permanent staff as the fundamental solution.
Spells out the reinforcing loop in which agency use erodes preceptorship, which raises attrition and creates more gaps and more agency use.
Keeps agency cover as a tapered bridge, even using it to backfill mentor time, while restarting preceptorship first.

pitfalls.why: Correctly identifies the archetype as Shifting the Burden, not Fixes That Fail.
Recommends capping and tapering agency use rather than stopping it outright.
